sessions.name: Test Cohort 1
sessions.description:
• Gain economic frameworks to understand and manage network businesses
  • Understand cost/benefit aspects of platform-based network businesses
  • Identify strategic considerations for two-sided and multi-sided platform businesses
sessions.summary: This lecture covers some of the most fundamental principles behind what makes digital platforms powerful business models. Aside from the economic forces of Network effects and economies of scale, we will cover the workings of two- and multi-sided platforms, the challenge of single- vs. multi-homing, and the role of switching costs in customer retention.

sessions.name: Test Cohort 2
sessions.description:
• Learn frameworks for evaluating customer value and engagement
  • Identify the challenges of using online advertising to grow your business
  • Understand how to correctly account for biases in measuring ad ROI
sessions.summary: This lecture describes the many challenges of implementing and measuring the success of growth strategies behind customer acquisition and retention. The most problematic aspects of measuring ROI on digital (or any) advertising efforts will be uncovered and tools to overcome these challenges will be presented.

sessions.name: Test Cohort 3
sessions.description:
• Learn the fundamentals of Net Neutrality and its impact on the online ecosystem
  • Appreciate the subtleties of nascent competition and the role of Acqui-hiring
  • Understand the debate around online privacy and the impacts privacy regulation
sessions.summary: This last lecture discusses the way in which the ground is constantly shifting under the feet of digital platforms with the increasing amount of scrutiny that regulators across all continents are focusing on the so-called “big tech” companies. We will briefly explore the economic analyses of the pros and cons of net neutrality, how regulators are trying to apply and modify competition policy in platform markets, and the pressing issues around data privacy and ownership.
